name: Bead of Force

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Throw
powers.text: Magic action: throw it up to 60 ft. It bursts: creatures within 10 ft make a DC 15 Dex save or take 5d4 Force and are trapped in a sphere of force for 1 minute.

summary: Thrown, it bursts (Dex DC 15, 5d4 Force) and traps those who fail in a sphere of force for a minute.
text: A tiny black sphere 3/4 of an inch across and weighing an ounce; these usually turn up in batches of 1d4 + 4. As a Magic action you can hurl one up to 60 feet. On impact it bursts in a 10-foot-radius Sphere and is destroyed, and each creature there rolls a Dexterity saving throw against DC 15, taking 5d4 Force damage if it fails. For the next 1 minute a transparent globe of force seals the area. Creatures that failed and are entirely inside are trapped in it; those that succeeded, or are only partly inside, get shoved outward from the center until they are clear of it. Nothing but breathable air crosses the globe's wall; attacks and all other effects are blocked.
